}}'''Bakh''' was a soldier from the [[Borderlands]] in [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Bakh|Bakh}}

== Activities ==
Bakh fights in the Borderlander army at [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. He always had a crossbow tied to the back of his horse, despite Lan's warning that it might go off accidentaly. {{ref||Bakh}}

== Death ==
His sword got caught in a Trolloc's armor, then he is pulled off his horse by two [[Trolloc]]s. Bakh kills one with the crossbow shot to the eye. The other runs him through, but not before Bakh also mortally wounds the Trolloc with his boot knife.{{Ref/book|14|9}}

==Trivia==
*Bakh is named after Bach Payson, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
